hypotheses.F0_final_bank_transfers: The correct final-position family bank beats the wrong-family median by at least 0.03 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.F1_correct_family_wins: The correct final-position family bank beats the wrong-family median on at least 65% of examples in every cell.
hypotheses.F2_final_bank_beats_sequence_bank: A position-matched bank beats the original sequence bank by at least 0.03 in every cell.
hypotheses.F3_native_basis_is_privileged: The native final-position bank beats an exactly rotated coordinate bank by at least 0.05 in every cell.
hypotheses.F4_oracle_gap_remains: The per-example native oracle exceeds the final family bank by at least 0.10 in every cell.
hypotheses.F5_ood_retention: TinyStories final-bank fidelity is at least 75% of FineWeb fidelity at each layer.
hypotheses.F6_scopes_share_nonrandom_but_distinct_c: Final and sequence banks have median Jaccard above 0.05 but below 0.50 at each layer.
hypotheses.F7_final_patch_has_measurable_effect: The median full-final-position patch Fisher energy exceeds 1e-8 in every cell.
